# Sample Agent Repo

This fixture mimics a small agent/workflow repository.
Start from `skills/example/SKILL.md` when running the operator workflow.
Use `prompts/reviewer-prompt.md` before changing behavior.
Launch the runtime with `scripts/start-example.sh`.
Validate the Python flow through `tests/test_example.py`.
This repo believes disciplined review is safer than fast guessing.
Operators should verify changes before claiming success.
Escalate instead of improvising when approval loops break down.
